_comment: The new-career intro (AW-234). The game reads this for captions and timing; tools/audio/narrate.py reads it to render the voiceover (public/assets/intro/vo-<n>.ogg). "say" is how the narrator should pronounce a line when it differs from the caption. Motion: start and end transforms of the panel (scale, x and y offsets in % of the frame).

scenes.text: In the 2060s, the machines learned to do everything. Some of us refused to be kept.
scenes.say: In the twenty-sixties, the machines learned to do everything. Some of us refused to be kept.

scenes.text: In 2071, two million of us left aboard the Intrepid, bound for Kepler-186. A voyage of four thousand years.
scenes.say: In twenty seventy-one, two million of us left aboard the Intrepid, bound for Kepler one eighty-six. A voyage of four thousand years.

scenes.text: We slept. Earth kept talking to us across the dark. No one listened.
Two-thirds of the way there, something opened in front of us.
We woke among stars no one had ever charted, and started the calendar again: After Waking.
Thirty years on, the Intrepid is a city that cannot move. Its reactors are failing, its decks are crowded, and the crystal that folds space is running out.
You've just signed for a third-rate freighter and a debt to the Exchange. Find fuel. Find what we need. Maybe find us a home.
